output.text: {"notes":["The requested readout is at absolute simulation time t=1.0 s for the load’s world-frame position, swing angle, angular velocity, and boundary-crossed flag.","World coordinates are right-handed with x forward, y left, and z up; position is in metres, swing angle in radians, and angular velocity in radians per second.","The scheduled intervention runs on [0.552, 0.752) s: support acceleration is +0.5400770503211028 m/s² for 0.1 s, then the same magnitude in the negative direction for 0.1 s, after which the support is stationary.","The boundary-crossed channel indicates whether the load center of mass crosses x=0.1 m with 0.005 m hysteresis after the observation cutoff."]}
